secondaryWorld.name: Kursbuch (Operator console)
secondaryWorld.scope: data_pipeline/dashboard_server.py (CSS/JS embedded in Python string literals)
secondaryWorld.overview: The owner's private control room for the house BTC 15-minute pipeline. Same timetable world the authed customer app now shares in spirit: ink on warm grey stock, hairline rules, no shadow/gradient/glass/card, tabular lining figures, Archivo + Archivo Narrow at two weights, one reserved signal red, and two stocks (grey paper vs rose live). Recorded before Recursive existed and still live; the full record is kept intact in DESIGN.md's final section. The customer App world above is this world's rules carried onto the product, so cross-reference rather than duplicate.
secondaryWorld.relationToApp: The authed App world and this console are the same visual system (identical token values, same Archivo/Narrow type, same signal-red discipline). They differ only in container licence: the console forbids any filled card (sections + one plate), while the App world permits bordered, unshadowed filled panels (.panel, .sheet-doc, .chat, .split) because the customer surface needs grouped explanation. No shadow rule still holds in both.

landing.overview: The pre-login Persuade surface, copied in spirit from catalyst.app: a near-white ground (l-bg #FBFBFA), near-black Rubik ink (l-ink #15161A), one warm accent (l-accent #F05A28) spent only on the logo cube's lit face and the preview's live-spinner, rounded pill buttons, and a single product-preview browser mock on a soft textured gradient panel. Calm, roomy, rounded; the opposite of the dense timetable behind the login.
keyCharacteristics: Pills at 999px radius; the only accent-carrying marks are the cube and the spinner.
One hero, one deck, one CTA pair, one preview panel.
Warm textured gradient panel + floating white window with traffic-light chrome.
No tables, no hairline rules, no signal red; this world never shows money state.
rules: Accent is reserved: l-accent appears only in the cube's lit face and the live-spinner, never as a button fill or body colour.
One warm orange, not the app's signal red: the landing never uses --signal (#C8102E).
dos: Keep the ground white and the ink near-black; let whitespace carry the calm.
Use pills (solid for primary, outline for secondary) at full 999px radius.
Confine the accent to the logo and the spinner.
donts: Do not bring hairline rules, stock tints, tables or signal red onto the landing.
Do not spend the accent on a button fill or large field.
Do not uppercase the Rubik sentences.

app.northStar: Kursbuch (The Station Timetable), carried onto the product
app.overview: The authed customer SPA is the operator console's timetable world applied to a retail trader: ink on warm grey stock (#E9EBE5), hairline rules, 2px ink section rules, tabular lining Archivo figures, dense tables over cards, a measure grid for figure rows, a single status line stating what the system is doing now, and ONE reserved signal red (#C8102E) spent only where the operator must act - stale data, paused/stopped deployments, armed/live money, the caret. P&L direction rides a desaturated tint field (pos/neg) behind an ink figure, never a coloured number. No shadow, gradient, glass or blur exists; depth is rule weight plus four stock tints. The live surface swaps to a rose stock. It differs from the console only in permitting bordered, unshadowed filled panels for grouped explanation the customer needs.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo + Archivo Narrow, weights 400/600, tabular lining figures everywhere.
One reserved signal red for attention and the live-money boundary; direction told by a tint field, not colour.
Every screen opens with a status line; sections carry freshness; stale is a visible struck-through state.
Dense ruled tables and a measure grid, not cards.
No shadow anywhere; the one monospace is the collapsed raw-spec JSON block.
rules: Reserved signal: --signal only on attention/live-money (stale, needs, armed, live, danger/stop, caret, live-row). Never a losing number, heading or decoration.
Money rides a field: .fig.tint.pos/.neg behind an ink figure; the figure itself never takes colour (.gain/.loss both resolve to ink).
State never by colour alone: PAPER/PASSED/LIVE/PAUSED words and shapes survive greyscale.
Printed depth: rule it or tint it, never lift it - no shadow in the app world.
dos: Open every page with a status line; put the measured result first.
Tell P&L direction with a pos/neg tint field behind an ink figure.
Keep tabular-nums lining-nums on anything numeric.
Give every table .stack + data-lab so it restacks under 760px.
Reserve uppercase for short Narrow labels; write sentences in sentence case.
donts: Do not add a shadow, gradient, glass or a coloured P&L number.
Do not spend signal red on anything but attention or the live-money boundary.
Do not add a third family, a third weight, or a radius beyond the 3px nick (pills excepted for chip/switch).
Do not let paper and live stocks converge; live is the rose stock plus signal masthead/tab.
